answer_4.quote: We now measure agreement of one human participant per language pair with this gold standard. [...] We recruited individuals whose mother tongue is not English and who have lived in the US or UK for at least one year at one point in their lives. [...] The acceptability judgment task was operationalised as follows: We told annotators to select from a sentence pair the one that had been produced by another bilingual.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to select the sentence produced by another bilingual, with the other sentence altered.
